scientific_integrity: The all-length result is reduced to a 256-state, 737-transition min-plus recurrence and exact componentwise length-six versus length-thirteen vector identity; all finite checks are integer arithmetic and reproducible in the included scripts. The infinite-strip density and circular-strip exact formula are attributed to prior literature.
scientific_limitations: Two-row undirected open ladders, radius-one closed-neighborhood identification. Minimum sizes and equality with published circular optima are asserted; no full classification of optimizers, larger-width generalization, or independent audit.
title: Boundary neutrality for radius-one identification in finite ladder networks
